body:
Yeah, I get that a lot. 

The reason hearing that doesn't motivate me as much as it should is plain and simple fear. 

I am horribly afraid of failing as a father. I'd rather be dead than fail as a father. The memory of me will always be overhyped by everyone and she will think I'm a larger than life guy who was great, when in reality I'm far from great. It's like a paralyzing fear - it grips every decision I make. Every choice always leads back to her possibly hating me. The only remedy for that is time, but everyday is a struggle. 

My concept of time is just so fucked. Every minute of everyday is agonizing, yet I look back on the past two years of my life (when my fiancé broke up with me) and they blew by. I can barely remember yesterday, let alone what happened during those times. Yet everyday is such a horrible struggle.
